targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, status AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM project_research_runs WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY time, status ORDER BY time

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(llm_name,''), '(unset)') AS "LLM", COALESCE(NULLIF(llm_model,''), '-') AS "Model", count(*) AS "Calls" FROM project_task_retrospects WHERE generated_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY llm_name, llm_model ORDER BY "Calls" DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT t.name AS "Workspace", count(*) FILTER (WHERE pt.status = 'done' AND pt.completed_at > now() - interval '24 hours') AS "Done 24h", count(*) FILTER (WHERE pt.status = 'in_progress') AS "In Progress", count(*) FILTER (WHERE pt.status = 'todo') AS "Todo" FROM project_tasks pt JOIN projects p ON p.id = pt.project_id JOIN teams t ON t.id = p.workspace_id GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY "Done 24h" DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('queued','running')) AS "Research running", (SELECT count(*) FROM project_tasks WHERE status = 'in_progress') AS "Tasks in progress", (SELECT count(*) FROM iosdist_sign_tasks WHERE status IN ('pending','running')) AS "iOS sign queued", (SELECT count(*) FROM chat_threads WHERE last_message_at > now() - interval '1 hour') AS "Threads active 1h" FROM project_research_runs

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, CASE WHEN llm_config_name = '' OR llm_config_name IS NULL THEN 'human' ELSE 'bot' END AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM chat_messages WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days' AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY time, metric ORDER BY time

SELECT date_trunc('day', uploaded_at) AS time, COALESCE(visibility, 'private') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM markdown_entries WHERE uploaded_at > now() - interval '14 days' GROUP BY time, visibility ORDER BY time
